name: Sunny Scribe
title: Whispering Quill Sage

ability.name: Golden Page Shield
ability.text: Prevents all damage until end of turn if she holds pen.

attacks.name: Brewed Brilliance
attacks.text: She scribbles notes; enemies giggle then vanish into sunlight.

attacks.name: Sunbeam Scribble Storm
attacks.text: Her quills rain golden ink; foes glow briefly before fading away.

flavor: Writes spells on napkins while sipping tea. Her stories make sunflowers dance.
pose: Leaning back slightly, holding stylus mid-scribble, eyes twinkling mischievously.
scene: Pastel sky behind her as glowing parchment floats around her writing desk.
